notes: National Rail (Darwin/OpenLDBWS) is structurally catalogued here but blocked at the account level - DARWIN_LDB_TOKEN not set. Same blocker as every other UK region in this wave.

SINGLE National Rail hub, unlike Glasgow's two: Edinburgh Waverley (EDB) is the one hub-lock; Haymarket (HYM) and Slateford (SLA) are through-running satellite stations on the same route network, not independent termini serving different corridors. See docs/edinburgh-d1/jim-handoff.md.

None of the three National Rail groups need internal doNotGroup (no evidence of separate platform/boarding-section logic per operator, unlike london-se-national-rail's London Bridge/Liverpool Street) - each is a single flat departure board, destination + operator.
CRS codes EDB/HYM/SLA are carried from the oracle report and NOT independently verified against a live GTFS dump or Darwin response (crsVerified: false).

Edinburgh Trams (T50, Transport for Edinburgh/Edinburgh Trams Ltd): a conventional point-to-point line with two confirmed termini (Newhaven, Edinburgh Airport), 7-10 minute headway. Standard line+terminus direction model, see lib/cities/edinburgh/tram-directions.js and docs/edinburgh-d1/direction-model-memo.md Part 1. No confirmed real-time feed - TfE Open Data API is closed/inactive, no successor confirmed. Schedule-only v1 remains unresolved; static GTFS (DFT BODS) is confirmed reachable (OGL 3.0) but NOT fetched or parsed by this pack.

Tram station list carries only 22 named stops (report line 21 list, transcribed verbatim into published-network.json's stations array) even though the oracle report's prose states '23 stops' in several places (report lines 23, 49, 69, 83) - a count discrepancy inside the pack itself, not resolved or padded here. Do not invent a 23rd stop.

Tram stop ORDER is UNVERIFIED - the oracle report's line 21 list reads as a plausible end-to-end sequence but was never confirmed as an ordered stop_sequence against an official Edinburgh Trams map or the DFT BODS GTFS. stationOrderVerified: false carried forward, not guessed. See lib/providers/edinburgh.js EdinburghTramsFeedUnverifiedError.

doNotGroup: Edinburgh Waverley (Trams, Waverley area stop) vs Edinburgh Waverley (National Rail, EDB) - separate platforms/infrastructure, no automatic interchange described in the report, different operator. See lib/cities/edinburgh/tram-directions.js DO_NOT_GROUP_PAIRS. Haymarket (Trams stop) vs Haymarket (National Rail, HYM) is nearby but similarly kept as two distinct catalog entries by mode - not merged, no evidence either way needs enforcement beyond mode-scoped lookup.

Falkirk High (FKK) was historically EXCLUDED here as a boundary-ownership question between this pack and Glasgow's — docs/united-kingdom-ledger.md section 2 resolved it (Tim, 5 Sep 2026): Edinburgh's boundary station, Edinburgh-Glasgow via Falkirk High is Edinburgh's flagship commuter corridor. Added to this catalog 13 Sep 2026 (UK station fill phase 1, docs/uk-station-fill/assignment.md) now that Tim's walk-up rule requires every Darwin-reachable National Rail station to be catalogued, not just hub/termini.
Caledonian Sleeper is EXCLUDED at Edinburgh Waverley only - board-eligibility verdict out-reservation (compulsory berth booking, no walk-up boarding).

Edinburgh Park (National Rail station, EDP) was historically EXCLUDED as out of D1 scope (only the Trams stop, Edinburgh Park Central, was catalogued in v1). Added to this catalog 13 Sep 2026 (UK station fill phase 1) — Darwin-verified. Note it shares a printed name with the Trams stop 'Edinburgh Park' (Trams uses 'Edinburgh Park Central' as its own distinct name, so no doNotGroup collision exists between the two).

13 Sep 2026 (UK station fill phase 1, docs/jim-brief-uk-station-fill-phase1.md, docs/uk-station-fill/{source,assignment,unverified}.md): National Rail catalog expanded from the original 3-station hub set to 37 stations — every Darwin-verified station in the City of Edinburgh council area plus East/Midlothian/West Lothian commuter stations into Waverley, per Tim's rule ('any station with an API is in'). Fife Circle stations north of the Forth stay rest-of-scotland's, per the assignment rule. doNotGroup added: Edinburgh Gateway (National Rail, new) vs Edinburgh Gateway (Trams, existing) — same printed name, separate infrastructure/operator, see lib/cities/edinburgh/tram-directions.js DO_NOT_GROUP_PAIRS.

lat/lng superseded 7 Sep 2026 (uk-catalog-geocode) — the oracle report itself gave no coordinate source, but NaPTAN carries confirmed stop-level coordinates for both National Rail (RailReferences, CRS-keyed) and Edinburgh Trams (StopType MET, "(Edinburgh Trams)" suffix); see the Coordinates note below.

Coordinates: NaPTAN RailReferences (CRS->coords) pulled 2026-09-07; 3/3 rail stations geocoded | NaPTAN StopType MET ("(Edinburgh Trams)" suffix — Newhaven-extension stops are filed under Tyne-and-Wear-prefixed ATCO codes in this NaPTAN export, so matched by name suffix, not ATCO prefix) pulled 2026-09-07; 22/22 tram/metro stops geocoded; no exceptions

7 Sep 2026 (docs/jim-brief-no-live-feed-stops-out-of-picker.md): all 22 Edinburgh Trams (mode metro) stops flagged liveFeed: false — EdinburghTramsFeedUnverifiedError means no board can ever be produced, so these stops stay in the catalog (coordinates kept for coverage notes and a future re-enable) but are no longer offered in the station picker or Near me. National Rail (mode train) stops are unaffected.

stops.name: Edinburgh Waverley
stops.class: Main National Rail hub, 20 platforms. ScotRail primary operator; LNER (London-Edinburgh ECML); Avanti West Coast / CrossCountry / TransPennine Express through-running. Single flat departure board, destination + operator, no internal doNotGroup. doNotGroup vs the Trams T50 hub-lock (also 'Edinburgh Waverley' in name, separate platforms/infrastructure, no automatic interchange described in the report). Caledonian Sleeper excluded, out-reservation.

stops.name: Haymarket
stops.class: Through-running satellite of the Edinburgh Waverley hub, National Rail only (the T50 line separately calls a Haymarket tram stop nearby, but that is the Trams line's own stop, not this station - not merged). West End interchange, second busiest station in Edinburgh, on the Glasgow-Edinburgh corridor and West Coast Main Line services. Single flat departure board, destination + operator.

stops.name: Slateford
stops.class: Through-running satellite of the Edinburgh Waverley hub, National Rail only. Shotts Line junction, intermediate station on the Glasgow-Edinburgh corridor. Flagged for D2 de-dup against Glasgow's National Rail slice if/when both regions are live simultaneously.
